contract: F-24, runtime-sources.yaml: release 1 reads only its bundled copy, through validateRuntimeSources (src/shared/runtime-sources.ts), whole-file

verdicts.accepts: the file validates; `families` lists the engine families it yields
verdicts.drops: the whole file is refused: that reader runs no engine

files.why: the llama_cpp block alone (the others are optional)
a later release adds a family as a new top-level key: ignored, whatever it holds
new keys at the top level, in a family block and in a build are ignored
as built, arch is any non-empty string: a build for an arch no Kit runs is accepted and never selected (the writer duty still forbids a new os or arch value inside an existing family block)
size_bytes is a dialog label: a bad one reads as unknown, never fails the file
a new os value inside a known family block refuses the whole file (no engine at all)
one malformed block of a known optional family refuses the whole file, llama_cpp included
an ocr dest that leaves the drive refuses the whole file
a cleartext url refuses the whole file
two builds for one (os, arch, backend) refuse the whole file
a known family that is no mapping refuses the whole file
a kiwix_tools executable with an extension refuses the whole file
